searchText: Sometimes the speaker doesn't know there is a problem. I have a relatively nice mic, but in a call recently there was static on the line from an unknown source and I didn't find out until after the call. Sometimes, people just are using crappy laptop mics. :) if you already have airpods they work surprisingly well
